# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Style

A TanStack Start SSR React app with file-based routing, two server route handlers for lead intake, and a static Black Friday landing page under `public/blackfriday/`, with no database layer.

### Directory layout

```
.github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml  # CI: push to main → curl POST to Coolify deploy API
Dockerfile                            # node:22-alpine multi-stage; NITRO_PRESET=node-server; EXPOSE 3000
.env.example                          # runtime env names for Coolify (values never committed)
public/
  blackfriday/                        # static Black Friday LP: index.html, css/, js/, privacy/, thank-you/, assets/
  favicon.ico, favicon.png, apple-touch-icon.png
scripts/
  smoke.mjs                           # post-build HTTP smoke test: lead endpoints, routes, tracking (npm run smoke)
  download-assets.mjs                 # fetches binaries for src/assets/*.asset.json stubs
  optimize-images.sh                  # image optimization helper
src/
  assets/                             # brand + portfolio images, lp/ landing images (.webp + .jpg), *.asset.json stubs
  components/
    landing/                          # chrome, hero, sections, interactive (FAQ + contact form), portfolio, vsl, primitives, site-data
    ui/                               # 46 shadcn/ui (new-york) primitives over Radix
  hooks/use-mobile.tsx
  lib/                                # *.server.ts (lead, bf-lead, meta-capi), lead-schema.ts, public-config.ts, tracking.ts, error-capture.ts, error-page.ts, lovable-error-reporting.ts, utils.ts
  routes/
    __root.tsx                        # HTML shell, head meta, Pixel/GA4 scripts, public-config loader, 404, error boundary
    index.tsx                         # "/" landing page composition
    thank-you.tsx                     # /thank-you: browser Lead event after a confirmed submit
    api/lead.ts                       # POST /api/lead → handleLead
    blackfriday/api/lead.ts           # POST /blackfriday/api/lead → handleBfLead
  routeTree.gen.ts                    # generated by router plugin; do not edit
  router.tsx                          # getRouter(): routeTree + QueryClient context
  server.ts                           # SSR entry wrapper (tanstackStart server entry = "server")
  start.ts                            # createStart + errorMiddleware
  styles.css                          # Tailwind 4 theme
vite.config.ts                        # @lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config defineConfig; nitro preset from NITRO_PRESET
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer                                                                 | Owns                                                                                                                                           | Does NOT own                                                |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| Server entry (`src/server.ts`, `src/start.ts`)                        | Lazy-loading the server entry; turning thrown errors and h3-swallowed 500s into an HTML error page                                             | Routing, rendering, business logic                          |
| Router (`src/router.tsx`, `src/routes/`)                              | Route tree, head/meta, Pixel/GA4 script injection, HTML shell, 404, error boundary, `QueryClientProvider`, `/thank-you` page, API route wiring | Section content, CRM delivery                               |
| Lead handlers (`src/lib/lead.server.ts`, `src/lib/bf-lead.server.ts`) | Payload validation, honeypot drop, E.164 phone normalization, n8n forwarding, CAPI call after n8n 2xx                                          | Rendering, browser events                                   |
| Meta CAPI client (`src/lib/meta-capi.server.ts`)                      | Server `Lead` event: SHA-256 user data, POST to Graph API `v23.0`, failure log only                                                            | Lead forwarding decisions                                   |
| Shared schema (`src/lib/lead-schema.ts`)                              | `leadSchema`, `SERVICE_OPTIONS` (zod only)                                                                                                     | Server I/O                                                  |
| Landing components (`src/components/landing/`)                        | Copy, content arrays, layout, contact form submit and client validation, VSL and browser tracking calls                                        | Persistence, CRM delivery                                   |
| UI primitives (`src/components/ui/`)                                  | Accessible Radix-based widgets (accordion, select, input, button, sonner)                                                                      | Brand copy                                                  |
| Browser lib (`src/lib/`)                                              | `cn` class merge, error capture/page/reporting, `tracking.ts` event helpers and Pixel/GA4 snippets, `public-config.ts` loader                  | Lead validation on the server                               |
| Static Black Friday LP (`public/blackfriday/`)                        | Standalone HTML/CSS/JS page, form, attribution capture, `config.js` values                                                                     | Route handlers (they live in `src/routes/blackfriday/api/`) |
| Scripts (`scripts/`)                                                  | Downloading asset binaries at dev time; post-build smoke test                                                                                  | Runtime behavior                                            |

### External integration points

| System                       | Client/config                                                                                                                                                                               | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| n8n lead webhook             | `fetch` in `src/lib/lead.server.ts`; `LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL`                                                                                                                                     | JSON body; 2xx required; 10 s timeout                                                                                                                                                       |
| n8n Black Friday webhook     | `fetch` in `src/lib/bf-lead.server.ts`; `BF_LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL`                                                                                                                               | 15 s timeout; workflow "LP Black Friday 2026" feeds Kommo (code comment)                                                                                                                    |
| Meta Conversions API         | `fetch` to `https://graph.facebook.com/v23.0/{pixel}/events` in `src/lib/meta-capi.server.ts`; `META_PIXEL_ID`, `META_CAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `META_CAPI_TEST_EVENT_CODE`, `META_CAPI_BASE_URL` | Requires both `META_PIXEL_ID` and `META_CAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN` (no-op if either is empty); 5 s timeout; `META_CAPI_BASE_URL` is for the smoke test (code comment)                               |
| Meta Pixel (browser)         | `pixelSnippet()` in `src/lib/tracking.ts`, injected in `src/routes/__root.tsx`                                                                                                              | Loads `https://connect.facebook.net/en_US/fbevents.js`. `/`: when `META_PIXEL_ID` is valid. `/blackfriday`: ID hardcoded in `public/blackfriday/js/config.js`, loads only outside localhost |
| Google Analytics 4 (browser) | `gtagSnippet()` in `src/lib/tracking.ts`; `<script src>` in `src/routes/__root.tsx`                                                                                                         | Loads `googletagmanager.com/gtag/js` when `GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID` is valid                                                                                                                     |
| Coolify                      | `.github/workflows/coolify-deploy.yml`                                                                                                                                                      | `POST https://aguiardev.online/api/v1/deploy?uuid=…&force=false`, header `Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_TOKEN` (secret `COOLIFY_API_TOKEN`)                                                |
| Lovable error events         | `src/lib/lovable-error-reporting.ts`                                                                                                                                                        | `window.__lovableEvents?.captureException`, mechanism `react_error_boundary`                                                                                                                |
| Lovable preview host         | `scripts/download-assets.mjs`                                                                                                                                                               | `https://id-preview--${project_id}.lovable.app${url}`                                                                                                                                       |
| Google Fonts                 | `src/routes/__root.tsx` links                                                                                                                                                               | Playfair Display 400–700, Inter 300–700                                                                                                                                                     |

### Macro flow: SSR request and error handling

```
GET /  ──►  src/server.ts fetch()
              │  import("@tanstack/react-start/server-entry") (memoized)
              ▼
           start.ts errorMiddleware ──throw w/o statusCode──► 500 renderErrorPage()
              │
              ▼
           router.tsx getRouter() ──► __root.tsx RootShell ──► index.tsx Index
              │
              ▼
           Response ──► normalizeCatastrophicSsrResponse()
              │  status>=500 && JSON {"unhandled":true,"message":"HTTPError"}?
              ├── yes ──► console.error(consumeLastCapturedError()) ──► 500 HTML error page
              └── no  ──► response as-is
```

- `src/lib/error-capture.ts` records the last `error` / `unhandledrejection` on `globalThis` and keeps it for `TTL_MS = 5_000`.

### Macro flow: lead intake

```
browser  POST /api/lead (JSON)
   │
   ▼
handleLead ──► parse JSON ──fail──► 400 validation_failed
   │  not a JSON object ──► 400 validation_failed
   │  company filled ──► 200 {"ok":true}, nothing sent (checked before schema)
   │  leadSchema.safeParse ──fail──► 400 validation_failed
   ▼
fetch LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL (n8n, 10 s) ──non-2xx──► 502 upstream_error
   │                               ──timeout──► 504 upstream_timeout
   │ 2xx
   ▼
sendCapiLead (Graph API v23.0) ──failure──► log capi_failed only
   │
   ▼
200 {"ok":true} ──► browser stores mtr_lead_event_id, sets location /thank-you
                 ──► thank-you.tsx trackLead(id)  (browser Lead, same event_id)
```
